source: Democracy Fund Voter Study Group / YouGov, VOTER Survey Panel, 2017 wave, via Ryan Burge (github.com/ryanburge).
method: Population: religpew_2017, weighted by weight_2017. Feeling-thermometer mean toward gays and lesbians (0=coldest/most unfavorable, 100=warmest/most favorable); sentinel codes excluded before averaging. PROVISIONAL: derived from the already-computed matrix JSON (same method/population), not recomputed from microdata directly - the source .dta was unreachable when this was generated. Per-cell unweighted n's and an 'All respondents' row are pending a re-run of the real compute script once the data drive is available.
